sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Specifically through the service in the present time of the heels of Moshiach, when darkness covers the earth, one reaches the revelations of the future redemption.

translations.translation: And 4)
And based on all the above, it will be understood that specifically through the service now in the time of the heels of Moshiach, when "darkness will cover the earth"69
one comes to the revelations of the future redemption.
For specifically in this time,
when one must deal with sparks of holiness that have fallen into an impure place,
and one must turn bitterness into sweetness and darkness into light,
and even to the point that from time to time one goes out from the four cubits of Torah,
or from the four cubits of prayer,
to leave the synagogue and the study hall,
and in the language of the Shulchan Aruch: "Treat them with a manner of derech eretz"70,
nevertheless, specifically through the service now one brings about the future redemption,
for then will be fulfilled what is stated71
"And you will be gathered one by one,"
each and every one of Israel and all of Israel,
"and their silver and their gold with them"72,
with all the sparks of holiness that belong to them, and also those found in their silver and gold literally.
Because in this service during the time of exile there is the matter of mesiras nefesh to the utmost.
And it is known from the teaching of our master the Alter Rebbe
(and at length in the maamarim of the Nasi of our generation, my master, father-in-law, and teacher, the Rebbe73)
on the verse74
"And the man Moshe was very humble, more than any man upon the face of the earth,"
that the humility of Moshe
(Moshe is truth and his Torah is truth75)
was specifically connected to the generation of the heels of Moshiach,
when he saw their mesiras nefesh in the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos in the matter of "do not be ashamed before those who mock"76
etc. and the like.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This brings about the fulfillment of the promise that the humble will rejoice in G-d, the joy of the true and complete redemption brought specifically through spreading the wellsprings outward.

translations.translation: And this brings about the fulfillment of the promise: "And the humble will add joy in Hashem"77,
"everlasting joy upon their heads"78,
the joy of the true and complete redemption,
which comes specifically through the spreading of the wellsprings outward79,
and in a manner of "they are redeemed immediately"80
and in a manner of "He redeemed [them] in peace,"
without any exertion,
until the promise will be fulfilled81
"And kings will be your caretakers and their princesses your nurses,"
"and they will bring"82
"all your brothers etc. as an offering to Hashem etc. in a pure vessel etc.,"
very soon,
in the days of the final exile83,
and afterwards, immediately and completely in actuality, in the true and complete redemption through Moshiach our righteousness,
speedily in our days, literally.
